title: Knapp and Corbell broke the Fravor Tic Tac story on radio before the New York Times

tellings.quote: is George Knapp and I did break the Commander Fravor story, the Tic Tac story. We did it quietly on the radio twice before the 2017 New York Times article.

plain: A filmmaker named Jeremy Corbell says that he and a journalist, George Knapp, were the first to tell the story of Commander David Fravor, a Navy fighter pilot who reported chasing the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint. Corbell says they did it quietly on the radio twice, before a 2017 New York Times article made the story famous. He tells it to claim credit for breaking one of the best-known modern UFO accounts.
